race.comment: BEYOND MYSTI (4) took a sit behind the pace then went through her gears in great style to record an effortless win over this course and distance last start at the second run back. Returned a career-best figure third-up last prep when successful so there is improvement to come. Expect her to handle this class rise and can win again. SENSATIONAL SECRET (8) returned from a six-week let-up with a dogged win here at this distance last time out. Given another five-week let-up since which is obviously the key to her. Perfectly drawn and right in contention. Lightly raced mare CANNY MISS (6) went around at $1.70 and looked to have every chance but missed the placings recently over 1250m at the Parks circuit. Dominated here at this trip the start before so she deserves another chance. KORATORA (11) was well held by BEYOND MYSTI two back then demolished a midweek field here at this distance last start. Each-way hope. STAR SIRIUS (1) can improve at the third run back from a spell.
